clips.title: The story
paras: In Blackfathom Deeps, Ghamoo-ra guards a small island in the Pool of Ask'ar. The ancient giant turtle tramples anyone who comes near.

Blackfathom Deeps was once a night elven temple to Elune. Flooded now, the ruins are claimed by naga, satyr, and the nihilistic Twilight's Hammer cult. Ghamoo-ra dwells among them, his enormous, thick shell turning aside all but the most determined blows.
Lesser turtles surround Ghamoo-ra on a small island in the Pool of Ask'ar, and they leave travelers be. He alone attacks, crushing anyone who comes near beneath his trampling bulk.
